title: Essential for soccer lovers
text: It is a very beautiful museum; it allows you to delve into the history of the club and learn about the context related to the history of the country. I didn't buy a ticket for the experience to see the works, though, because it almost doubled the price just to see something that is under construction.
author: X9345RVpabloj

title: Barca Store Airport Barcelona
text:
Good morning.
This morning 17/11/2025 09:40 I had the pleasure of visiting the Store Barça at the airport. As I watched the shop early in the morning, I noticed that a group of workers was talking among themselves about travel and personal anecdotes: that if one had gone to Almeria, that if another had flown on a plane with only a propeller... information that, without looking for it, reached me equally.
As he left the store, missing at least one “good day,” a young man appeared with a calm air, folding some T-shirts. He felt my presence and, as an unexpected little gift, I heard that greeting
author: 116albertinae
